ValidationRule.description: Keeps the data underwriting is reviewing identical to what was sent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(Account__c), ISCHANGED(Requested_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Use_of_Funds__c)), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Draft"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Validation Failed"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Send Failed"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Needs More Info"))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This application is with underwriting. Business, Requested Amount and Use of Funds can't change until it's decided or fails to send.
